properties.name: MEASURED 2026-10-03 on main c4e1cbd: a --shared (and --remote) call whose ARGUMENTS hold the JSON string "initialize" is taken for a handshake — posted with no session, it gets NO REPLY, and every later call in the session fails (422)
properties.statement: Found while placing the read-only screen (item 1b). proxy.rs recognised the handshake with `line.contains("\"initialize\"")` in forward_lines (--shared) and run_remote_with_notice (--remote, a pointer-attached client), while run_waiting already parsed the method (is_initialize, written for exactly this). OBSERVED: `--shared`, tools/call search_design {"query":"initialize"} → no reply within 90 s; the next call → JSON-RPC error "the replacement shared reflow2 server did not answer either: the reflow2 server answered 422 Unprocessable Entity". Over --remote the call was posted as a fresh handshake with no mcp-session-id and the session id was dropped for every later call (a stand-in recorded `-` where `s-1` was expected). With or without --read-only. A screen placed after that branch could have been bypassed through it. FIXED in the same change: both loops use is_initialize (the parsed method). Pinned by a_shared_call_that_mentions_initialize_is_not_taken_for_a_handshake and without_read_only_a_remote_client_forwards_every_call, both observed failing on main.
